name: fmp_stock_list
description:
Listed stocks covered by Financial Modeling Prep (FMP), with symbol and name.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/stock-list as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): limit (integer; sent only when given).
To find a ticker by company name use fmp_symbol_search; for filtered lists fmp_stock_screener.
Example: {"limit": 50}
